meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: Claude 会把一个目录、一个网址、粘进来的笔记,或刚才这段对话,提炼成一个可复用的技能文件 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md;若已有同名技能,则就地补充新内容而非重写。
howto.when: 当你说「/learn」并附上目录、网址或粘贴的笔记,或提到「learn this」「capture this workflow」等说法时触发;若你点名某个已有技能,则转入更新流程。

say.note: 读取项目结构与关键文件后写出新技能
把这次对话里的步骤和踩过的坑整理成技能

say.text: 更新一下 wow-on-steam-deck 这个技能
say.note: 先读现有 SKILL.md,再就地改进

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or the work just done in this conversation into a reusable skill at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, or refines an existing skill with new learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/learn' with a directory, URL, or pasted notes, or phrases like 'learn this' or 'capture this workflow'. Naming an existing skill switches to updating it in place.

say_en.text: /learn ./my-project — build a skill for this project
say_en.note: Reads structure and key files, then writes the skill
Distills this session's steps and gotchas into a skill
Reads the current SKILL.md, then edits it in place
